title: A fabricated identity document passes as genuine
mechanism_summary: A financial-crime advisory describes suspected use of deepfake identity documents. Fraudsters submit them to bypass verification at financial institutions.
suggested_beats: An applicant supplies identity evidence.
A synthetic document supports a false identity.
Verify documents beyond their visual appearance.
why_it_works: Authentic-looking formatting can make fabricated evidence seem routine.

title: An altered family photo supports a ransom demand
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes criminals altering public photos to claim a loved one has been kidnapped. The fabricated proof accompanies urgent ransom demands.
suggested_beats: A kidnapping claim arrives.
An altered photo is presented as proof.
Contact the loved one independently and seek help.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone worried about an unreachable loved one
why_it_works: Apparent visual proof can intensify fear and urgency.

title: A delivery photo is altered to exaggerate damage
mechanism_summary: A news report describes a social-media claim that AI was used to exaggerate damage to delivered food. The account claimed the altered photo secured a refund; the report is not independent proof of every claim.
suggested_beats: A delivery has limited visible damage.
An altered image supports a larger refund claim.
Verify claims against original evidence.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone reviewing a photographic refund claim
why_it_works: Photographic evidence can appear objective even when altered.

title: Generated disaster images solicit fraudulent donations
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes criminals using AI disaster or conflict images in charity scams. The fabricated scenes encourage donations to fraudulent causes.
suggested_beats: An urgent appeal shows distressing imagery.
A donation request relies on the synthetic scene.
Verify the charity independently.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone moved to help during a crisis
why_it_works: Compassion can be redirected by fabricated visual evidence.

title: A fraudulent website uses an AI chatbot to guide visitors
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes AI chatbots embedded in fraudulent websites. The bots encourage visitors to follow malicious links.
suggested_beats: A website offers responsive assistance.
The chatbot directs the visitor to a harmful link.
Verify the website before following its guidance.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone seeking help on an unfamiliar website
why_it_works: Responsive conversation can make a fraudulent site seem legitimate.

title: A synthetic receipt supports a false insurance claim
mechanism_summary: An insurance regulator warns of fabricated receipts generated with AI. The documents are presented as evidence for fraudulent claims.
suggested_beats: A claim includes a plausible receipt.
The document conceals a fabricated expense.
Check original records and document authenticity.
why_it_works: Familiar formatting can make an invented expense seem documented.

title: AI damage pictures support fraudulent claims
mechanism_summary: An insurance advisory describes generated damage photographs used as false evidence. A realistic image can support a claim without documenting the actual condition of the property.
suggested_beats: A claim arrives with damage photos.
The pictures misrepresent the underlying evidence.
Verify against original and independent records.
why_it_works: Visual realism can hide the absence of an actual documented loss.

title: Synthetic product images make a shopping site look established
mechanism_summary: A government-distributed warning describes fake shopping sites using AI product images and generated reviews. The polished presentation creates an illusion of legitimacy.
suggested_beats: An unfamiliar store displays convincing products.
Synthetic content substitutes for a trustworthy trading history.
Check the seller through independent evidence.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone shopping at an unfamiliar online store
why_it_works: A polished catalogue can be mistaken for proof that a seller is genuine.
